title: Marine-Derived Fungal Metabolite MHO7 Promotes Breast Cancer Apoptosis as a Hippo Pathway Regulator by Modulating the YAP-TEAD Axis.
authors: Ren, Xue; Wang, Linfei; Huang, Yuxuan; Shu, Bei; Hou, Kerui; Chen, Mengyao; Xiao, Yao; Liang, Jiahong; Yan, Hao; Ding, Shuaishuai; Qiu, Hui; Lu, Jin; Hong, Kui; Liu, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海洋真菌代谢物MHO7通过调控YAP-TEAD轴抑制乳腺癌，涉及TEAD蛋白-蛋白互作与分子对接，但核心是药物抗肿瘤机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅含简单对接，与课题相关性中等。
abstract: Breast cancer, especially triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and endocrine-resistant disease, remains difficult to treat because of limited effective targeted therapies. In this study, we evaluated the antitumor activity and potential mechanism of MHO7, a marine-derived ophiobolin metabolite, in ER-positive ZR-75-30 cells, tamoxifen-resistant LCC2 cells, and TNBC MDA-MB-231 models. MHO7 dose-dependently reduced cell viability, wound closure, and clonogenic growth in ZR-75-30 and LCC2 cells, with IC(50) values of 11.53 and 10.43 muM, respectively. MHO7 also promoted apoptotic cell death, accompanied by increased reactive oxygen species accumulation and altered expression of apoptosis-related proteins, including Bcl-2 and caspase-3. N-acetyl-L-cysteine partially attenuated MHO7-induced apoptosis and YAP reduction in MDA-MB-231 cells, suggesting a contribution of oxidative stress. Molecular docking predicted that MHO7 could occupy the conserved TEAD palmitoylation pocket, and subsequent in vitro analyses showed suppression of YAP/TAZ-TEAD signaling, including reduced YAP nuclear accumulation and decreased TEAD4 expression. In an MDA-MB-231 xenograft model, MHO7 significantly inhibited tumor growth, reduced CD31-positive microvessel density, and decreased Hippo pathway-related transcriptional readouts. These findings indicate that MHO7 exerts broad antitumor activity in breast cancer models through oxidative stress-associated apoptosis and modulation of YAP/TAZ-TEAD signaling, supporting its further development as a lead compound for treatment-resistant breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌，尤其是三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）和内分泌耐药性疾病，由于有效的靶向治疗选择有限，仍然难以治疗。在本研究中，我们评估了海洋来源的蛇孢菌素代谢物MHO7在ER阳性ZR-75-30细胞、他莫昔芬耐药LCC2细胞以及TNBC MDA-MB-231模型中的抗肿瘤活性及其潜在机制。MHO7剂量依赖性地降低了ZR-75-30和LCC2细胞的细胞活力、伤口愈合能力和克隆形成生长，其IC(50)值分别为11.53和10.43 μM。MHO7还促进了凋亡性细胞死亡，伴随活性氧积累增加以及凋亡相关蛋白（包括Bcl-2和caspase-3）表达的改变。N-乙酰-L-半胱氨酸部分减弱了MHO7诱导的MDA-MB-231细胞凋亡和YAP减少，提示氧化应激的贡献。分子对接预测MHO7可能占据保守的TEAD棕榈酰化口袋，随后的体外分析显示YAP/TAZ-TEAD信号通路受到抑制，包括YAP核积累减少和TEAD4表达降低。在MDA-MB-231异种移植模型中，MHO7显著抑制了肿瘤生长，减少了CD31阳性微血管密度，并降低了Hippo通路相关的转录读数。这些发现表明，MHO7通过氧化应激相关凋亡和YAP/TAZ-TEAD信号通路的调节，在乳腺癌模型中发挥广泛的抗肿瘤活性，支持其作为治疗耐药性乳腺癌的先导化合物进一步开发。
